name: Storyboard
long_description:
Introducing Storyboard, the leading platform designed to connect the world's top brands, innovative creative agencies, and dynamic influencers with their communities on Instagram and Snapchat.

Our mission is to simplify and enhance your online presence on Instagram and Snapchat, offering a comprehensive suite of powerful and intuitive features:

1. Seamless Automation: Storyboard enables smooth, automatic sharing of your stories between Instagram and Snapchat. No more manual cross-platform management, saving you time while maintaining content consistency.

2. Advanced Performance Tracking: Measure the impact of your efforts with our advanced performance analytics toolkit. Gain in-depth insights into engagement, reach, and other essential metrics, empowering you to adjust your strategy in real time for optimal results.

3. Strategic Planning: Anticipate your campaigns by scheduling your stories and posts in advance. Our user-friendly interface lets you create a consistent editorial calendar, ensuring your content reaches your audience at the right times.

Discover how Storyboard can transform your presence on Instagram and Snapchat. Join visionary brands already placing their trust in Storyboard to optimize their social media presence. Whether you're a large corporation or an independent creative, our scalable platform will continue to deliver exciting new features to propel your online impact.
one_liner: Social media management tool for Instagram and Snapchat

app_answers.question: Describe what your company does in 50 characters or less.
What is your company going to make? Please describe your product and what it does or will do.
app_answers.answer:
Snapsuite is a toolbox for Brands, Agencies and Influencers who publish content on Snapchat.

1. Publish: Snapchat app offers limited features and inconvenient workflows for Professionals. With Snapsuite, Publishers can post programmatically scheduled Stories with content created from any sources. 

2. Take-Over: Brands love take-overs. They give their Snapchat credentials to guests for 24 hours with *full* access. Snapsuite manages permissions safely for take-overs. We also provide a simple workflow where account owners can review Stories before their publications.

3. Analytics: How many followers do you have on Snapchat? Professionals have to count them manually. Same for the number of views of each story ...that disappears after 24 hours. Snapsuite collects those data and make them available through relevant reports and KPIs.

4. Competitors Analysis: Same as Analytics ...but for Competitors.

We will also support Instragram Stories in the future.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Sébastien Sikorski is an entrepreneur who has built multiple large-scale applications, garnering millions of users.

Sébastien was the founding employee of the leading French dating application AdopteUnMec and successfully led the revamp of the RATP app, the public transportation application for Paris and its regions. Additionally, he teaches at Sciences Po Paris.

At Ingenuity, Sébastien is now helping startups and corporates reach their best potential.
